title: Accelerating Distributed Deep Learning using Multi-Path RDMA in Data Center Networks
authors: Feng Tian; Yang Zhang; Wei Ye; Cheng Jin; Ziyan Wu; Zhi-Li Zhang
venue_full: ACM SIGCOMM Symposium on Software Defined Networking Research

problem_statement.en: Standard RDMA is a point-to-point transport mechanism that cannot utilize the rich multi-path topology of modern data center networks, leading to congestion and sub-optimal performance for distributed deep learning workloads.
problem_statement.zh: 標準 RDMA 屬於點對點傳輸機制，無法利用現代資料中心網路豐富的多路徑拓撲，導致分散式深度學習工作負載面臨壅塞與效能不佳的問題。

key_innovation.en: Maestro, a purely software-based multi-path RDMA middleware that uses virtual NICs (vNICs) to enable path control, message decomposition into chunks, and flexible, application-aware load balancing without modifying existing RDMA hardware.
key_innovation.zh: Maestro 是一套純軟體的多路徑 RDMA 中介層，藉由虛擬 NIC（vNICs）實現路徑控制、訊息分塊，以及彈性的應用感知負載均衡，無需修改現有 RDMA 硬體。

key_improvements.en: Up to 66.7% reduction in transport time for DDL applications and effective bandwidth aggregation with negligible CPU overhead.
key_improvements.zh: 分散式深度學習應用的傳輸時間最高降低 66.7%，並在幾乎不增加 CPU 額外負擔的情況下實現有效頻寬聚合。

title: Alibaba HPN: A Data Center Network for Large Language Model Training
authors: Kun Qian; Yongqing Xi; Jiamin Cao; Jiaqi Gao; Yichi Xu; Yu Guan; Binzhang Fu; Xuemei Shi; Fangbo Zhu; Rui Miao; Chao Wang; Peng Wang; Pengcheng Zhang; Xianlong Zeng; Eddie Ruan; Zhiping Yao; Ennan Zhai; Dennis Cai
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication

problem_statement.en: Traditional 3-tier Clos data center networks suffer from hash polarization and single-point failures (ToR) when handling the bursty, low-entropy traffic patterns of large-scale LLM training. This leads to uneven traffic distribution and significant performance degradation during synchronous training iterations.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統三層 Clos 資料中心網路在處理大規模 LLM 訓練的突發性低熵流量時，容易出現雜湊極化與 ToR 單點故障，進而導致流量分配不均，並在同步訓練迭代期間造成顯著的效能下滑。

key_innovation.en: HPN introduces a 2-tier, dual-plane architecture with non-stacked dual-ToR switches and a rail-optimized network design to eliminate hash polarization, improve fault tolerance, and support 15K GPUs within a single Pod.
key_innovation.zh: HPN 採用兩層雙平面架構，配合非堆疊式雙 ToR 交換器與 rail 優化的網路設計，以消除雜湊極化、提升容錯能力，並在單一 Pod 內支援 15K GPU。

evaluation_and_results.baselines_compared: DCN+, traditional 3-tier Clos Data Center Network

key_improvements.en: 14.9% higher end-to-end LLM training throughput, 59.3% AllReduce performance increase, 91.8% reduction in ToR downstream port queue length, and zero ToR-related single-node failures in 8 months.
key_improvements.zh: 端到端 LLM 訓練吞吐量提升 14.9%、AllReduce 效能提升 59.3%、ToR 下游埠佇列長度減少 91.8%，且在 8 個月內 ToR 相關的單節點故障次數為零。

title: Alto: Orchestrating Distributed Compound AI Systems with Nested Ancestry
authors: Deepti Raghavan; Keshav Santhanam; Muhammad Shahir Rahman; Nayani Modugula; Luis Gaspar Schroeder; Maximilien Cura; Houjun Liu; Pratiksha Thaker; Philip Levis; Matei Zaharia
affiliations: Brown University, Nvidia, Stanford University, UC Berkeley, Carnegie Mellon University

problem_statement.en: Existing compound AI systems fail to fully leverage parallelism and pipelining because they rely on blocking input-output relationships and struggle to manage the heterogeneous data granularities produced by intermediate computations.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的複合 AI 系統由於依賴阻塞式輸入輸出關係，且難以管理中間計算所產生的異質資料粒度，因此無法充分發揮平行處理與 pipeline 的潛力。

key_innovation.en: Alto introduces 'nested ancestry', a metadata hierarchy that automatically tracks data provenance through a computation graph, enabling the system to correctly route, stream, parallelize, and aggregate partial outputs across distributed components.
key_innovation.zh: Alto 引入「巢狀溯源」（nested ancestry）機制——一套自動追蹤計算圖中資料來源的元資料層級結構，使系統得以正確地跨分散式元件進行路由、串流、平行化與部分輸出的聚合。

key_improvements.en: 2.3x higher throughput at the same median latency SLO of 6 seconds for FacTool; 10-30% latency improvement across evaluated applications.
key_improvements.zh: 在 FacTool 中間延遲 SLO 同為 6 秒的條件下，吞吐量提升 2.3x；跨評估應用的延遲改善幅度為 10–30%。

title: Amplifying Effective CXL Memory Bandwidth for LLM Inference via Transparent Near-Data Processing
authors: Rui Xie; Asad Ul Haq; Linsen Ma; Yunhua Fang; Zirak Burzin Engineer; Liu Liu; Tong Zhang
affiliations: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, Wiseburn Da Vinci Science

problem_statement.en: LLM inference is bottlenecked by the limited effective bandwidth and capacity of CXL-based memory pools, which struggle to keep up with the high demands of model weights and expanding KV caches.
problem_statement.zh: LLM inference 受限於 CXL 記憶體池有效頻寬與容量不足，難以應對模型權重與持續擴張的 KV cache 所帶來的高需求。

key_innovation.en: CXL-NDP, a transparent near-data processing architecture for CXL memory devices that uses a precision-scalable bit-plane layout and transparent lossless compression to amplify effective bandwidth without modifying the CXL.mem interface.
key_innovation.zh: CXL-NDP 是針對 CXL 記憶體裝置的透明近資料處理架構，採用精度可調的 bit-plane 佈局與透明無損壓縮，在不修改 CXL.mem 介面的前提下放大有效頻寬。

key_improvements.en: 43% inference throughput increase, 87% context length extension, 40.3% lower DRAM access energy, 42.1% lower model-load latency, 25.2% weight footprint reduction, 46.9% KV cache footprint reduction.
key_improvements.zh: inference 吞吐量提升 43%、context 長度延伸 87%、DRAM 存取能耗降低 40.3%、模型載入延遲降低 42.1%、權重記憶體占用減少 25.2%、KV cache 記憶體占用減少 46.9%。

title: An Extensible Software Transport Layer for GPU Networking
authors: Yang Zhou; Zhongjie Chen; Ziming Mao; ChonLam Lao; Shuo Yang; Pravein Govindan Kannan; Jiaqi Gao; Yilong Zhao; Yongji Wu; Kaichao You; Fengyuan Ren; Zhiying Xu; Costin Raiciu; Ion Stoica
affiliations: UC Berkeley, UC Davis, Tsinghua University, Harvard University, IBM Research, Amazon Web Services, University Pollitehnica of Bucharest, Broadcom

problem_statement.en: Existing RDMA NIC hardware transport layers are difficult to evolve, leading to performance bottlenecks such as flow collisions, poor congestion control for ML workloads, and inefficient loss recovery.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 RDMA NIC 硬體傳輸層難以演進，導致流量碰撞、ML 工作負載的壅塞控制不佳，以及低效率的封包遺失恢復等效能瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: UCCL, an extensible software transport layer that decouples the data and control paths of RDMA NICs, allowing transport logic (congestion control, multipathing, loss recovery) to be implemented and updated in user-space CPU code.
key_innovation.zh: UCCL 是一套可擴展的軟體傳輸層，將 RDMA NIC 的資料路徑與控制路徑解耦，使壅塞控制、多路徑、封包遺失恢復等傳輸邏輯得以在使用者空間的 CPU 程式碼中實作與更新。

key_improvements.en: Up to 4.5x higher throughput for ML collectives, 4.9x better message tail latency for network incast, and significant performance gains in distributed training and MoE serving.

title: An Introduction to the Compute Express Link (CXL) Interconnect
authors: Debendra Das Sharma; Robert Blankenship; Daniel Berger
affiliations: Intel Corporation, University of Washington, Microsoft

problem_statement.en: The paper addresses the limitations of traditional PCIe and DDR interfaces, specifically the lack of coherent access to system/device memory, memory scalability bottlenecks, resource stranding in datacenters, and high communication latency for fine-grained data sharing in distributed systems.
problem_statement.zh: 本文探討傳統 PCIe 與 DDR 介面的局限性，包括缺乏對系統/裝置記憶體的一致性存取、記憶體擴展性瓶頸、資料中心的資源閒置，以及分散式系統中細粒度資料共享的高通訊延遲。

key_innovation.en: The Compute Express Link (CXL) is an open industry-standard interconnect that multiplexes coherency, memory, and I/O protocols (CXL.cache, CXL.mem, CXL.io) over the PCIe physical layer to enable memory disaggregation, pooling, and coherent shared memory.
key_innovation.zh: CXL（Compute Express Link）是一種開放的業界標準互連技術，透過在 PCIe 實體層上多工 CXL.cache、CXL.mem 與 CXL.io 等協定，實現記憶體解耦、池化與一致性共享記憶體。

key_improvements.en: CXL 3.0 enables scaling to 4,096 endpoints, doubles per-pin bandwidth to 64 GT/s, and provides sub-microsecond communication latency for fine-grained data sharing compared to traditional network-based approaches.
key_improvements.zh: CXL 3.0 可擴展至 4,096 個端點、每 pin 頻寬倍增至 64 GT/s，並相較於傳統網路方案提供次微秒級的通訊延遲，以支援細粒度的資料共享。

title: Asynchronous Verified Semantic Caching for Tiered LLM Architectures
authors: Asmit Kumar Singh; Haozhe Wang; Laxmi Naga Santosh Attaluri; Tak Chiam; Weihua Zhu

problem_statement.en: Production tiered LLM caches use a single static similarity threshold that forces a trade-off between conservative thresholds that miss reuse opportunities and aggressive thresholds that risk serving incorrect responses.
problem_statement.zh: 生產環境的階層式 LLM 快取依賴單一靜態相似度閾值，在保守閾值（錯失重用機會）與激進閾值（可能回傳不正確回應）之間強制取捨。

key_innovation.en: Krites, an asynchronous, LLM-judged caching policy that verifies static cache misses in the similarity grey zone off-path and promotes approved matches into the dynamic cache via an auxiliary overwrite.
key_innovation.zh: Krites 是一種非同步、由 LLM 判斷的快取策略：對靜態快取未命中但落在相似度灰色地帶的查詢進行離線驗證，並將通過審核的匹配項目透過輔助覆寫提升至動態快取。

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.9x increase in static-origin served fraction (136% for conversational, 290% for search) with unchanged critical path latency.
key_improvements.zh: 靜態快取命中比例最高提升 3.9x（對話場景提升 136%，搜尋場景提升 290%），且關鍵路徑延遲維持不變。

workload_and_traffic.ai_task: LLM Serving, Semantic Caching

title: Autellix: An Efficient Serving Engine for LLM Agents as General Programs
authors: Michael Luo; Xiaoxiang Shi; Colin Cai; Tianjun Zhang; Justin Wong; Yichuan Wang; Chi Wang; Yanping Huang; Zhifeng Chen; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Ion Stoica
affiliations: UC Berkeley, Google DeepMind, Shanghai Jiao Tong University

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems treat LLM calls as independent requests, ignoring program-level dependencies and context, which leads to head-of-line blocking and suboptimal end-to-end latency for agentic programs. This results in significant waiting times for programs as they scale their inference computation.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統將每次 LLM 呼叫視為獨立請求，忽略程式層級的依賴關係與上下文，導致 agentic 程式出現隊頭阻塞（head-of-line blocking）與次優的端到端延遲；隨著 inference 計算規模擴大，程式等待時間也隨之顯著增加。

key_innovation.en: Autellix introduces a stateful serving engine that treats agentic programs as first-class citizens, utilizing program-level statistics (cumulative service time) to inform scheduling and load balancing. It proposes two non-clairvoyant scheduling algorithms, PLAS (for single-threaded) and ATLAS (for multi-threaded DAGs), to prioritize calls based on program progress.
key_innovation.zh: Autellix 引入一套有狀態的 serving 引擎，將 agentic 程式作為一等公民，利用程式層級統計資訊（累計服務時間）指導 scheduling 與負載均衡。其提出兩種非預知型 scheduling 演算法：PLAS（針對單執行緒）與 ATLAS（針對多執行緒 DAG），依據程式進度對呼叫進行優先排序。

key_improvements.en: 4-15x throughput increase at the same latency compared to vLLM; up to 1.5x throughput improvement over standard load-balancers across engines.
key_improvements.zh: 在相同延遲條件下，吞吐量相較於 vLLM 提升 4–15x；跨引擎場景中相較於標準負載均衡器吞吐量最高提升 1.5x。

title: Beluga: A CXL-Based Memory Architecture for Scalable and Efficient LLM KVCache Management
authors: Xinjun Yang; Qingda Hu; Junru Li; Feifei Li; Yuqi Zhou; Yicong Zhu; Qiuru Lin; Jian Dai; Yang Kong; Jiayu Zhang; Guoqiang Xu; Qiang Liu

problem_statement.en: The limited capacity of GPU HBM necessitates offloading KVCache to host memory or remote pools, but existing RDMA-based disaggregated memory solutions suffer from high access latency, complex communication protocols, and significant synchronization overhead.
problem_statement.zh: GPU HBM 容量有限，迫使系統將 KV cache 卸載至主機記憶體或遠端記憶體池；然而現有基於 RDMA 的解耦記憶體方案存在存取延遲高、通訊協定複雜，以及同步開銷顯著等問題。

key_innovation.en: Beluga, a CXL 2.0-based memory architecture that enables GPUs and CPUs to access a shared, large-scale memory pool via CXL switches using native load/store semantics, eliminating the need for complex network stacks and bounce buffers.
key_innovation.zh: Beluga 是基於 CXL 2.0 的記憶體架構，允許 GPU 與 CPU 透過 CXL 交換器以原生 load/store 語義存取共享的大規模記憶體池，從而消除複雜網路協定棧與中繼緩衝區的需求。

key_improvements.en: 89.6% reduction in Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) and 7.35x throughput improvement in vLLM compared to RDMA-based solutions.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 RDMA 方案，TTFT 降低 89.6%，vLLM 吞吐量提升 7.35x。

title: CacheBlend: Fast Large Language Model Serving for RAG with Cached Knowledge Fusion
authors: Jiayi Yao; Hanchen Li; Yuhan Liu; Siddhant Ray; Yihua Cheng; Qizheng Zhang; Kuntai Du; Shan Lu; Junchen Jiang

problem_statement.en: Existing KV cache reuse methods like prefix caching and full KV reuse are either limited to prefix-only scenarios or fail to account for cross-attention between multiple text chunks, leading to sub-optimal performance or incorrect generation quality in RAG tasks.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 KV cache 重用方法（如 prefix caching 與完整 KV 重用）要嘛僅限於前綴場景，要嘛無法考量多文本段落間的跨注意力，導致 RAG 任務中效能次優或生成品質下降。

key_innovation.en: CacheBlend, a scheme that fuses multiple precomputed KV caches by selectively recomputing the KV values of a small subset of tokens (High-KV-Deviation tokens) to restore cross-attention, while pipelining this recomputation with KV cache retrieval to hide latency.
key_innovation.zh: CacheBlend 透過選擇性地重新計算少量 token（High-KV-Deviation tokens）的 KV 值來融合多個預計算的 KV cache，以恢復跨注意力；同時將此重計算與 KV cache 擷取進行 pipeline 以隱藏延遲。

key_improvements.en: 2.2–3.3x reduction in TTFT, 2.8–5x increase in inference throughput, and minimal generation quality loss compared to full KV recompute.
key_improvements.zh: TTFT 降低 2.2–3.3x，inference 吞吐量提升 2.8–5x，相較於完整 KV 重計算的生成品質損失極小。

title: Can LLMs Maintain Fundamental Abilities under KV Cache Compression?
authors: Xiang Liu; Zhenheng Tang; Hong Chen; Peijie Dong; Zeyu Li; Xiuze Zhou; Bo Li; Xuming Hu; Xiaowen Chu

problem_statement.en: Existing KV cache compression methods are primarily evaluated on long-context benchmarks, leaving their impact on fundamental LLM capabilities like arithmetic reasoning, world knowledge, and safety under-explored. Furthermore, these methods often fail to preserve semantic coherence in prompts, leading to significant performance degradation in complex reasoning tasks.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 KV cache 壓縮方法主要在長 context 基準上評估，對 LLM 基礎能力（如算術推理、世界知識與安全性）的影響尚未充分探索；此外，這些方法往往無法保留 prompt 的語義一致性，導致複雜推理任務效能大幅下降。

key_innovation.en: ShotKV, a novel compression framework that separates prefill and decoding phases, preserving complete shot examples during prefill to maintain semantic coherence while dynamically compressing tokens during decoding.
key_innovation.zh: ShotKV 是一種新穎的壓縮框架，將 prefill 與 decoding 階段分開處理：在 prefill 期間保留完整的示例（shot examples）以維持語義一致性，同時在 decoding 期間動態壓縮 token。

evaluation_and_results.baselines_compared: StreamingLLM, SnapKV, H2O, PyramidKV, PyramidInfer, ChunkKV

key_improvements.en: 9%-18% performance improvements on long-context generation tasks under aggressive compression ratios; maintains high performance on many-shot arithmetic reasoning where other methods degrade significantly.
key_improvements.zh: 在激進壓縮比下，長 context 生成任務效能提升 9%–18%；在其他方法顯著退化的多示例算術推理任務中仍維持高效能。

title: Collective Communication for 100k+ GPUs
authors: Min Si; Pavan Balaji; Yongzhou Chen; Ching-Hsiang Chu; Adi Gangidi; Saif Hasan; Subodh Iyengar; Dan Johnson; Bingzhe Liu; Regina Ren; Deep Shah; Ashmitha Jeevaraj Shetty; Greg Steinbrecher; Yulun Wang; Bruce Wu; Xinfeng Xie; Jingyi Yang; Mingran Yang; Kenny Yu; Minlan Yu; Cen Zhao; Wes Bland; Denis Boyda; Suman Gumudavelli; Prashanth Kannan; Cristian Lumezanu; Rui Miao; Zhe Qu; Venkat Ramesh; Maxim Samoylov; Jan Seidel; Srikanth Sundaresan; Feng Tian; Qiye Tan; Shuqiang Zhang; Yimeng Zhao; Shengbao Zheng; Art Zhu; Hongyi Zeng

problem_statement.en: Traditional collective communication libraries like NCCL face throughput and latency bottlenecks at the scale of 100k+ GPUs due to kernel-driven designs and copy-based data transfers. These limitations hinder efficient large-scale LLM training and low-latency inference.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統集合通訊庫（如 NCCL）在 100k+ GPU 規模下，因 kernel 驅動設計與基於拷貝的資料傳輸而面臨吞吐量與延遲瓶頸，進而阻礙大規模 LLM 訓練與低延遲 inference 的效率。

key_innovation.en: NCCLX, a host-driven collective communication framework featuring CTran, which implements zero-copy, SM-free data transfers, and Dynamic Queue Pair Load Balancing (DQPLB) to optimize communication across hierarchical network topologies.
key_innovation.zh: NCCLX 是以 host 驅動的集合通訊框架，搭載 CTran 實現零拷貝、無 SM 的資料傳輸，並透過 Dynamic Queue Pair Load Balancing（DQPLB）優化跨層次網路拓撲的通訊。

key_improvements.en: Up to 12% latency reduction per training step for Llama4, 11x faster training startup at 96k scale, and 15% to 80% end-to-end decoding latency improvement for inference.
key_improvements.zh: Llama4 每訓練步驟延遲最高降低 12%；在 96k GPU 規模下訓練啟動速度提升 11x；inference 端到端 decoding 延遲改善 15%–80%。

title: Continuum: Efficient and Robust Multi-Turn LLM Agent Scheduling with KV Cache Time-to-Live
authors: Hanchen Li; Qiuyang Mang; Runyuan He; Qizheng Zhang; Huanzhi Mao; Xiaokun Chen; Hangrui Zhou; Alvin Cheung; Joseph Gonzalez; Ion Stoica

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM inference engines use end-of-turn KV cache eviction, which causes significant recomputation or reloading overhead and per-turn queueing delays for multi-turn agentic workloads that interleave inference with variable-duration tool calls.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM inference 引擎在每輪結束後驅逐 KV cache，導致多輪 agentic 工作負載（inference 與不定時長的 tool call 交錯執行）面臨大量重計算或重載開銷，以及每輪的佇列等待延遲。

key_innovation.en: Continuum, a serving system that introduces a KV cache Time-to-Live (TTL) mechanism to selectively pin KV cache in GPU memory based on a cost-benefit model, combined with program-level first-come-first-serve scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: Continuum 是一套 serving 系統，引入 KV cache Time-to-Live（TTL）機制，依據成本收益模型選擇性地將 KV cache 保留在 GPU 記憶體中，並結合程式層級的先到先服務 scheduling。

evaluation_and_results.baselines_compared: vLLM, LMCache, Autellix, InferCept, SGLang, Dynamo

key_improvements.en: Reduces delay by 1.12x to 3.66x and improves throughput by 1.10x to 3.22x on multi-turn agentic workloads; reduces delay for real SWE-agent workloads by up to 8.18x.
key_improvements.zh: 在多輪 agentic 工作負載上，延遲降低 1.12x–3.66x，吞吐量提升 1.10x–3.22x；真實 SWE-agent 工作負載的延遲最高降低 8.18x。

title: DOPD: A Dynamic PD-Disaggregation Architecture for Maximizing Goodput in LLM Inference Serving
authors: Junhan Liao; Minxian Xu; Wanyi Zheng; Yan Wang; Kejiang Ye; Rajkumar Buyya; Chengzhong Xu
affiliations: Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Southern University of Science and Technology, Inner Mongolia University, The University of Melbourne, University of Macau

problem_statement.en: Static PD-disaggregation architectures suffer from producer-consumer imbalances due to heterogeneous LLM workloads and mixed-length requests, leading to resource wastage or SLO violations. The paper aims to dynamically adjust the prefill-to-decoding (P/D) ratio to maximize goodput and resource efficiency.
problem_statement.zh: 靜態 PD 解耦架構因異質 LLM 工作負載與混合長度請求而產生生產者-消費者失衡，導致資源浪費或 SLO 違規。本文旨在動態調整 prefill 與 decoding 的比例（P/D ratio），以最大化 goodput 與資源效率。

key_innovation.en: DOPD (Dynamic Optimal Prefill/Decoding), a framework that uses ARIMA-based load forecasting to compute an optimal P/D ratio and employs a length-aware request scheduling policy to mitigate resource mismatches under high concurrency.
key_innovation.zh: DOPD（Dynamic Optimal Prefill/Decoding）是一套框架，利用基於 ARIMA 的負載預測計算最優 P/D ratio，並採用感知請求長度的 scheduling 策略，以緩解高並發下的資源不匹配問題。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.5x increase in overall system goodput, up to 67.5% reduction in P90 TTFT, up to 22.8% reduction in P90 TPOT, and over 99% SLO attainment.
key_improvements.zh: 系統整體 goodput 最高提升 1.5x、P90 TTFT 降低最多 67.5%、P90 TPOT 降低最多 22.8%，SLO 達成率超過 99%。

title: DUALMAP: ENABLING BOTH CACHE AFFINITY AND LOAD BALANCING FOR DISTRIBUTED LLM SERVING
authors: Ying Yuan; Pengfei Zuo; Bo Wang; Zhangyu Chen; Zhipeng Tan; Zhou Yu
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huawei

problem_statement.en: Distributed LLM serving systems face a fundamental trade-off between cache-affinity scheduling (which maximizes KV cache reuse but causes load imbalance) and load-balancing scheduling (which distributes load evenly but degrades cache hit rates). Existing schedulers operate within a single mapping space, failing to achieve both objectives simultaneously.
problem_statement.zh: 分散式 LLM serving 系統在快取親和性 scheduling（最大化 KV cache 重用但導致負載不均）與負載均衡 scheduling（均勻分配負載但降低快取命中率）之間存在根本性取捨。現有 scheduler 在單一映射空間內運作，無法同時達成兩個目標。

key_innovation.en: DualMap, a dual-mapping scheduling strategy that maps each request to two candidate instances using independent hash functions and selects the optimal instance based on system state, effectively combining the 'power of two choices' for load balancing with prefix-aware mapping for cache affinity.
key_innovation.zh: DualMap 是一種雙映射 scheduling 策略，利用獨立雜湊函數將每個請求映射至兩個候選實例，再依據系統狀態選擇最優實例，有效地將「二選一」（power of two choices）的負載均衡與前綴感知映射的快取親和性相結合。

key_improvements.zh: 有效請求容量最高提升 2.25x；P50 TTFT 降低 55.4%–97.4%；P90 TTFT 降低 82.3%–97%。

problem_statement.en: Agentic LLM inference is bottlenecked by storage I/O imbalance in disaggregated architectures, where prefill engines are bandwidth-saturated while decoding engines remain idle. This leads to severe GPU underutilization during KV-Cache loading.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic LLM inference 在解耦架構中受制於儲存 I/O 失衡：prefill 引擎頻寬飽和，而 decoding 引擎卻閒置，導致 KV cache 載入期間 GPU 嚴重低利用。

key_innovation.en: DualPath introduces a dual-path KV-Cache loading architecture that enables loading KV-Cache into decoding engines and transferring it to prefill engines via RDMA, combined with a workload-aware scheduler to balance network and compute resources.
key_innovation.zh: DualPath 引入雙路徑 KV cache 載入架構：將 KV cache 載入 decoding 引擎後再透過 RDMA 傳輸至 prefill 引擎，並搭配感知工作負載的 scheduler 以平衡網路與計算資源。

problem_statement.en: Existing KV cache management systems treat eviction and compression as separate, sub-optimal processes, failing to account for varying context sensitivities to lossy compression and the resulting impact on generation quality and latency.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 KV cache 管理系統將驅逐與壓縮視為各自獨立的次優流程，未能考量不同 context 對有損壓縮的敏感程度差異，以及其對生成品質與延遲的影響。

key_innovation.en: A unified utility function that quantifies the trade-off between generation quality and loading delay, enabling joint, per-context optimization of lossy compression and multi-tier eviction.
key_innovation.zh: 一套統一的效用函數，量化生成品質與載入延遲之間的取捨，從而實現對有損壓縮與多層驅逐的逐 context 聯合最優化。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.19x faster TTFT at equivalent quality; 1.43-3.77x TTFT reduction compared to fixed compression/eviction baselines; 2.0-3.6x higher throughput at 80% quality target.

key_innovation.en: FlowKV introduces a KV cache structure optimization that enables contiguous tensor transfers to minimize NCCL calls, combined with a Load-Aware Scheduler for dynamic request routing and flexible node role allocation.
key_innovation.zh: FlowKV 引入 KV cache 結構優化，使連續張量傳輸成為可能，以最小化 NCCL 呼叫次數；並搭配負載感知 scheduler，實現動態請求路由與靈活的節點角色分配。

problem_statement.en: Existing high-speed congestion control schemes for RDMA networks struggle to simultaneously achieve ultra-low latency, high bandwidth utilization, and network stability, often leading to PFC storms or deep packet queues.

key_innovation.zh: HPCC（High Precision Congestion Control）利用網路內遙測（INT）獲取精確的鏈路負載資訊，使發送端得以計算準確的流量速率更新並控制在途位元組數，從而維持近零佇列。

problem_statement.en: The enormous memory footprint of the KV cache in LLM inference scales with sequence length and batch size, creating a performance bottleneck when offloading to CPU memory due to limited PCIe bandwidth. key_innovation.en: InfiniGen, a dynamic KV cache management framework that uses minimal rehearsal of attention computation to speculate and prefetch only essential KV cache entries from CPU memory, combined with offline weight skewing to improve speculation precision.
key_innovation.zh: InfiniGen 是一個動態 KV cache 管理框架，透過對 attention 計算進行輕量推演（minimal rehearsal），預測並僅從 CPU 記憶體中預取必要的 KV cache 項目；同時結合離線權重偏移（offline weight skewing）以提升推測精度。

key_innovation.en: KVCOMM, a training-free framework that enables efficient prefilling by reusing KV-caches and aligning cache offsets of overlapping contexts using an online-updated anchor pool of observed cache deviations.
key_innovation.zh: KVCOMM 是一個免訓練框架，藉由重用 KV cache 並利用線上更新的 anchor pool（記錄已觀察到的 cache 偏移量）來對齊重疊 context 的快取偏移，從而實現高效率的 prefilling。

key_improvements.en: Significant enhancement in long-context performance, particularly in retrieval tasks; 4x tokens in 4-bit precision outperforms 1x tokens in 16-bit precision.
key_improvements.zh: 長 context 效能顯著提升，尤其在檢索任務上表現突出；以 4-bit 精度存放 4x token 的效果優於以 16-bit 精度存放 1x token。

title: MTP: Transport for In-Network Computing
authors: Tao Ji; UT Austin; Rohan Vardekar; Balajee Vamanan; Brent E Stephens
venue_full: Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation
affiliations: UT Austin, University of Illinois Chicago, Google, University of Utah

problem_statement.en: Existing transport protocols like TCP, RDMA, and Homa fail to handle the unique attributes of In-Network Computing (INC) offloads, such as message mutation, interception, reordering, and unpredictable processing delays, leading to broken reliability and ineffective congestion control.
problem_statement.zh: 現有傳輸協定（如 TCP、RDMA、Homa）無法應對 In-Network Computing（INC）卸載所帶來的獨特屬性，包括訊息變異、攔截、重排序與不可預測的處理延遲，導致可靠性破壞與擁塞控制失效。

key_innovation.en: MTP (Message Transport Protocol), a message-oriented transport that decouples reliability from packet sequence numbers, uses per-message retransmission timeouts (RTOs) with pathlet-aware feedback (PRX/PTX ACKs), and implements a resource-specific congestion control framework with proactive pathlet switching.
key_innovation.zh: MTP（Message Transport Protocol）是一種以訊息為導向的傳輸協定，將可靠性與封包序號解耦，採用每訊息重傳超時（RTO）結合 pathlet 感知回饋（PRX/PTX ACK），並實作資源特定的擁塞控制框架與主動式 pathlet 切換。

key_improvements.en: 15% throughput increase for NetCache, 65% reduction in tail latency, and 10-20% higher load sustainability under heavy reordering.
key_improvements.zh: NetCache 吞吐量提升 15%，尾延遲降低 65%，在高度重排序場景下負載可持續性提高 10–20%。

title: Network Load Balancing with In-network Reordering Support for RDMA
authors: Cha Hwan Song; Xin Zhe Khooi; Raj Joshi; Inho Choi; Jialin Li; Mun Choon Chan
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication

problem_statement.en: RDMA traffic is highly sensitive to out-of-order packet arrivals, which trigger unnecessary loss recovery and rate reduction, while existing load balancing algorithms fail to effectively distribute RDMA traffic due to its continuous flow characteristics and lack of sufficient flowlet gaps.
problem_statement.zh: RDMA 流量對亂序封包到達高度敏感，容易觸發不必要的丟失恢復與速率降低；而現有負載均衡演算法因 RDMA 流量的連續流特性及 flowlet 間隔不足，難以有效分配 RDMA 流量。

key_innovation.en: ConWeave, a load balancing framework that performs fine-grained rerouting and masks out-of-order packet arrivals by using programmable switches to reorder packets in the network datapath.
key_innovation.zh: ConWeave 是一個負載均衡框架，透過可程式化交換機在網路資料路徑中對封包重排序，執行細粒度重路由並屏蔽亂序封包到達。

key_improvements.en: Up to 42.3% improvement in average FCT and 66.8% improvement in 99-percentile FCT compared to state-of-the-art algorithms.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最先進演算法，平均 FCT 改善最高 42.3%，99 百分位 FCT 改善最高 66.8%。

title: Nezha: SmartNIC-based Virtual Switch Load Sharing
authors: Xing Li; Enge Song; Bowen Yang; Tian Pan; Ye Yang; Qiang Fu; Yang Song; Yilong Lv; Zikang Chen; Jianyuan Lu; Shize Zhang; Xiaoqing Sun; Rong Wen; Xionglie Wei; Biao Lyu; Zhigang Zong; Qinming He; Shunmin Zhu
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Alibaba Cloud, RMIT University, Hangzhou Feitian Cloud

problem_statement.en: SmartNIC-based virtual switches (vSwitches) suffer from resource bottlenecks (CPU and memory) due to extreme load imbalances, where a few high-demand VMs overwhelm local SmartNICs while most remain underutilized. Existing solutions to offload these demands often require expensive new hardware or complex state synchronization.
problem_statement.zh: 基於 SmartNIC 的虛擬交換機（vSwitch）因負載嚴重不均而面臨 CPU 與記憶體資源瓶頸——少數高需求虛擬機使本地 SmartNIC 不堪負荷，而大多數 SmartNIC 卻閒置低用。現有卸載方案往往需要昂貴的新硬體或複雜的狀態同步機制。

key_innovation.en: Nezha, a distributed vSwitch load sharing system that decouples state from rule/flow tables, offloading stateless tables to a pool of idle remote SmartNICs while maintaining state locally in a single copy to eliminate synchronization overhead.
key_innovation.zh: Nezha 是一個分散式 vSwitch 負載共享系統，將狀態與規則/流表解耦：無狀態表卸載至閒置遠端 SmartNIC 池，而狀態以單一副本保留於本地，從而消除同步開銷。

key_improvements.en: Increased CPS by 3-4.4x, concurrent flows by 5.04-50.4x, and vNIC capacity by over 40x; resolved over 99.9% of vSwitch overloads.
key_improvements.zh: CPS 提升 3–4.4x，並發流數提升 5.04–50.4x，vNIC 容量提升超過 40x；vSwitch 過載問題解決率超過 99.9%。

title: Not All Bits Are Equal: How Model Scale Changes Memory-Optimal Reasoning
authors: Not Specified
venue_full: The Fourteenth International Conference on Learning Representations

problem_statement.en: Reasoning models generate significantly more tokens than non-reasoning models, causing the KV cache to become a dominant memory bottleneck that renders scale-agnostic memory optimization strategies ineffective.
problem_statement.zh: 推理模型（reasoning model）生成的 token 數量遠多於非推理模型，使 KV cache 成為主導性記憶體瓶頸，令與規模無關的記憶體最佳化策略失效。

key_innovation.en: A scale-dependent memory allocation framework for reasoning models that determines the optimal trade-off between model weight precision, effective model size, and KV cache compression (eviction vs. quantization) based on the model's effective size.
key_innovation.zh: 一個針對推理模型的規模相關記憶體分配框架，根據模型的有效規模，在模型權重精度、有效模型大小與 KV cache 壓縮方式（eviction 對比 quantization）之間確定最優取捨。

key_improvements.en: Identified a scale-dependent threshold (8-bit 4B effective size) for memory-optimal strategies; demonstrated that KV cache compression (eviction/quantization) consistently advances the Pareto frontier.
key_improvements.zh: 識別出記憶體最優策略的規模相關閾值（8-bit、4B 有效規模）；並驗證 KV cache 壓縮（eviction/quantization）能穩定推進 Pareto 前沿。

title: Octopus: Scalable Low-Cost CXL Memory Pooling
authors: Daniel S. Berger; Yuhong Zhong; Fiodar Kazhamiaka; Pantea Zardoshti; Shuwei Teng; Mark D. Hill; Rodrigo Fonseca
affiliations: Microsoft Azure, University of Washington, Columbia University, University of Wisconsin-Madison

problem_statement.en: Existing CXL pod designs assume a fully-connected topology, which limits pod size due to the high cost and rarity of multi-port pooling devices. This creates a bottleneck for scaling memory pooling and communication efficiency.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 CXL pod 設計假設全連接拓撲，因多埠 pooling 裝置高昂的成本與稀缺性而限制了 pod 規模，成為記憶體池化擴展與通訊效率的瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: Octopus, a minimally-connected CXL pod topology that uses near-commodity pooling devices with bounded connections, ensuring all host pairs share at least one pooling device while enabling larger, more cost-effective pods.
key_innovation.zh: Octopus 是一種最小連接 CXL pod 拓撲，採用接近商用的有界連接 pooling 裝置，確保所有主機對至少共用一個 pooling 裝置，同時支援更大規模且更具成本效益的 pod。

key_improvements.en: 2.1x reduction in CXL overhead costs, 3.25x reduction in RPC latency compared to RDMA, and memory savings comparable to expensive fully-connected designs.

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM services are request-centric and lack application-level knowledge, leading to sub-optimal end-to-end performance due to excessive network overhead, misaligned scheduling objectives, and redundant computations. This causes high latency and reduced throughput for complex LLM-based applications.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務以請求為中心，缺乏應用層知識，因而產生過多網路開銷、不一致的 scheduling 目標與冗餘計算，導致複雜 LLM 應用的端到端效能欠佳，延遲偏高且吞吐量受限。

key_innovation.en: Semantic Variable, a unified abstraction that exposes application-level knowledge (prompt structure and request correlations) to the LLM service, enabling data flow analysis, inter-request optimization, and application-centric scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: Semantic Variable 是一種統一抽象，將應用層知識（prompt 結構與請求關聯性）暴露給 LLM 服務，從而實現資料流分析、跨請求最佳化與以應用為中心的 scheduling。

key_improvements.en: Up to 11.7x speedup and 12x higher throughput compared to state-of-the-art solutions.

title: PLB: congestion signals are simple and effective for network load balancing
authors: Mubashir Adnan Qureshi; Yuchung Cheng; Qianwen Yin; Qiaobin Fu; Gautam Kumar; Masoud Moshref; Junhua Yan; Van Jacobson; David Wetherall; Abdul Kabbani
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication

problem_statement.en: Datacenter networks suffer from congestion hotspots caused by ECMP/WCMP hashing, which ignores flow sizes and leads to uneven link utilization and increased tail latency.
problem_statement.zh: 資料中心網路因 ECMP/WCMP 雜湊忽略流量大小而產生壅塞熱點，導致鏈路利用率不均與尾延遲上升。

key_innovation.en: PLB (Protective Load Balancing) is a host-based design that uses the IPv6 Flow Label to dynamically repath congested connections, leveraging existing transport-layer congestion signals to minimize reordering.
key_innovation.zh: PLB（Protective Load Balancing）是一種基於主機的設計，利用 IPv6 Flow Label 對壅塞連線動態重新路由，並借助現有傳輸層壅塞訊號以最小化重排序。

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems are not prompt-cache-aware in distributed environments, leading to inefficient KV computation and load imbalance when requests with shared prefixes are distributed across different GPUs.

key_innovation.en: Preble, a distributed LLM serving platform featuring the E2 (Exploitation + Exploration) scheduling algorithm that co-optimizes KV state reuse and computation load-balancing through a hierarchical scheduling mechanism.
key_innovation.zh: Preble 是一個分散式 LLM 服務平台，其核心為 E2（Exploitation + Exploration）scheduling 演算法，藉由階層式排程機制同步最佳化 KV 狀態重用與計算負載均衡。

key_improvements.en: 1.5x to 14.5x improvement in average latency and 2x to 10x improvement in p99 latency compared to SGLang.

title: RANDOMIZATION BOOSTS KV CACHING, LEARNING BALANCES QUERY LOAD: A JOINT PERSPECTIVE
authors: Fangzhou Wu; Sandeep Silwal

problem_statement.en: Existing KV cache eviction policies like LRU are fragile under dynamic query arrivals, and current load balancing heuristics fail to capture the coupling between cache state and system congestion. This leads to suboptimal cache hit rates and increased end-to-end latency in multi-LLM serving environments.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 KV cache 淘汰策略（如 LRU）在動態 query 到達下表現脆弱，而現有的負載均衡啟發式方法無法捕捉 cache 狀態與系統壅塞之間的耦合關係，導致多 LLM 服務環境中 cache hit rate 欠佳、端到端 latency 上升。

key_innovation.en: A unified mathematical model for KV cache-aware load balancing, combined with a Randomized Leaf Token (RLT) eviction algorithm and a Learning-Based Greedy Routing (LBGR) strategy that uses online regression to predict end-to-end latency.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 KV cache 感知負載均衡建立統一數學模型，並結合隨機葉節點 token（RLT）淘汰演算法與 Learning-Based Greedy Routing（LBGR）策略，藉由線上迴歸預測端到端 latency。

key_improvements.en: Up to 6.92x higher cache hit rate, 11.96x reduction in median latency, 14.06x reduction in TTFT, and 77.4% increase in throughput.
key_improvements.zh: cache hit rate 最高提升 6.92x，中位數 latency 降低 11.96x，TTFT 降低 14.06x，throughput 提升 77.4%。

title: RDMA over Ethernet for Distributed Training at Meta Scale
authors: Adithya Gangidi; Rui Miao; Shengbao Zheng; Sai Jayesh Bondu; Guilherme Goes; Hany Morsy; Rohit Puri; Mohammad Riftadi; Ashmitha Jeevaraj Shetty; Jingyi Yang; Shuqiang Zhang; Mikel Jimenez Fernandez; Shashidhar Gandham; Hongyi Zeng
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication

problem_statement.en: Distributed AI training at scale suffers from network congestion, load imbalance, and performance degradation due to the bursty, low-entropy traffic patterns of collective communication. Existing congestion control mechanisms like DCQCN are difficult to tune for these workloads, and standard routing schemes like ECMP fail to distribute traffic effectively.
problem_statement.zh: 大規模分散式 AI 訓練因 collective communication 的突發性低熵流量模式，而面臨嚴重的網路壅塞、負載失衡與效能下降。DCQCN 等現有壅塞控制機制難以針對此類 workload 進行調校，而 ECMP 等標準路由方案亦無法有效分散流量。

key_innovation.en: A co-designed approach for RoCE networks that replaces transport-level congestion control (DCQCN) with receiver-driven traffic admission via the collective library, combined with enhanced routing schemes (E-ECMP, Centralized Traffic Engineering) and topology-aware scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 RoCE 網路的協同設計方案：以 collective library 層的接收端驅動流量准入取代傳輸層壅塞控制（DCQCN），並搭配強化路由方案（E-ECMP、集中式 Traffic Engineering）與拓撲感知排程。

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM communication libraries are locked to specific NICs and rely on collective communication, which hinders dynamic scaling and portability across heterogeneous RDMA hardware like NVIDIA ConnectX and AWS EFA.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 通訊函式庫與特定 NIC 深度綁定，並依賴 collective communication，導致在 NVIDIA ConnectX 與 AWS EFA 等異質 RDMA 硬體間難以動態擴展與移植。

key_innovation.en: TransferEngine, a portable RDMA communication library that abstracts heterogeneous hardware by providing a uniform interface for two-sided SEND/RECV and one-sided WRITEIMM operations, utilizing a novel IMMCOUNTER primitive for completion notification that avoids ordering assumptions.
key_innovation.zh: TransferEngine 是一個可移植的 RDMA 通訊函式庫，藉由統一介面抽象異質硬體，支援雙向 SEND/RECV 及單向 WRITEIMM 操作，並引入新穎的 IMMCOUNTER 原語進行完成通知，從而避免對排序的假設。

authors: Guowei Liu; Hongming Li; Yaning Guo; Yongxi Lyu; Mo Zhou; Yi Liu; Zhaogeng Li; Yanpeng Wang

problem_statement.en: Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD) often fails to improve Hardware FLOPS Utilization (HFU) on standard clusters due to communication bottlenecks and load imbalance, creating a 'dead zone' where scaling FFN instances does not yield performance gains.
problem_statement.zh: Attention-FFN Disaggregation（AFD）在標準叢集上因通訊瓶頸與負載失衡，往往無法提升 Hardware FLOPS Utilization（HFU），形成一個「死區」——在此區間內，擴展 FFN 實例數量並不帶來效能增益。

key_innovation.en: A budget-based HFU upper-bound analysis method that extends the roofline model to the communication level, identifying the specific conditions (Superpod-class hardware, coarse-grained experts) where AFD is advantageous.
key_innovation.zh: 一種基於資源預算的 HFU 上界分析方法，將 roofline model 延伸至通訊層級，從而識別出 AFD 具有優勢的特定條件（Superpod 級硬體、粗粒度 expert 劃分）。

title: Revisiting Congestion Control for Lossless Ethernet
authors: Yiran Zhang; Qingkai Meng; Chaolei Hu; Fengyuan Ren
venue_full: Symposium on Networked Systems Design and Implementation
affiliations: Tsinghua University, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, Beihang University

problem_statement.en: Lossless Ethernet networks suffer from congestion spreading, Head-of-Line (HoL) blocking, and deadlock due to the limitations of Priority-based Flow Control (PFC) and sub-optimal congestion control schemes.
problem_statement.zh: 無損 Ethernet 網路因 Priority-based Flow Control（PFC）的局限性與次優壅塞控制機制，而面臨壅塞擴散、Head-of-Line（HoL）阻塞及死鎖等問題。

key_innovation.en: ACK-driven congestion control (ACC) that leverages the packet conservation property of lossless networks to infer network pipe capacity and excessive packets, using a two-step strategy of temporary source halting followed by rate matching.
key_innovation.zh: ACK 驅動的壅塞控制（ACC）：利用無損網路的封包守恆特性推斷網路管道容量及多餘封包數，採用「暫停發送端」後接「速率匹配」的兩階段策略。

key_improvements.en: 1.3~3.3x improvement in average FCT and 1.4~11.5x improvement in 99th percentile FCT for small flows compared to existing schemes.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於現有方案，小流的平均 FCT 提升 1.3~3.3x，第 99 百分位 FCT 提升 1.4~11.5x。

workload_and_traffic.ai_task: AI applications, Data processing, Storage workloads (NVMe-over-Fabrics)

title: Revisiting Disaggregated Large Language Model Serving for Performance and Energy Implications
authors: Jiaxi Li; Yue Zhu; Eun Kyung Lee; Klara Nahrstedt

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving frameworks often colocate prefill and decode stages, leading to resource interference, while disaggregated serving lacks systematic benchmarking of performance and energy efficiency across different KV cache transfer paths and optimization strategies.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務框架多將 prefill 與 decode 階段共置於同一節點，造成資源相互干擾；而解耦合服務方式則缺乏針對不同 KV cache 傳輸路徑及優化策略的系統性效能與能耗評測。

key_innovation.en: A comprehensive benchmarking study of prefill-decode disaggregation that evaluates multiple KV cache transfer paths (GPU P2P, CPU offloading, disk offloading) and assesses the energy implications of independent stage-wise frequency scaling using DVFS.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 prefill-decode 解耦合的全面評測研究：評估多種 KV cache 傳輸路徑（GPU P2P、CPU offloading、磁碟 offloading），並分析利用 DVFS 對各階段獨立進行頻率調節的能耗影響。

key_improvements.en: Disaggregated serving outperforms colocated serving in TPOT at high batch sizes due to reduced memory pressure, though it generally consumes more energy and exhibits higher TTFT when high-speed interconnects are unavailable.
key_improvements.zh: 在大 batch size 下，解耦合服務因記憶體壓力降低而在 TPOT 上優於共置方案；然而在缺乏高速互連的情況下，其能耗通常更高，且 TTFT 亦較長。

title: Scalable Processing-Near-Memory for 1M-Token LLM Inference: CXL-Enabled KV-Cache Management Beyond GPU Limits
authors: Dowon Kim; MinJae Lee; Janghyeon Kim; HyuckSung Kwon; Hyeonggyu Jeong; Sang-Soo Park; Minyong Yoon; Si-Dong Roh; Yongsuk Kwon; Jinin So; Jungwook Choi
venue_full: International Conference on Parallel Architectures and Compilation Techniques

problem_statement.en: Long-context LLM inference suffers from severe memory and compute bottlenecks due to the linear scaling of the KV-cache, which leads to costly data recall overheads and GPU memory pressure that limits batch sizes.
problem_statement.zh: 長 context LLM inference 因 KV cache 線性擴展而面臨嚴重的記憶體與計算瓶頸，導致高昂的資料召回開銷以及 GPU 記憶體壓力，進而限制 batch size。

key_innovation.en: A CXL-enabled Processing-Near-Memory (PNM) architecture that offloads KV-cache management and attention computation to PNM accelerators, combined with a hybrid GPU-PNM execution model using steady-token selection to maintain large batch sizes.
key_innovation.zh: 以 CXL 為基礎的 Processing-Near-Memory（PNM）架構：將 KV cache 管理與 attention 計算卸載至 PNM 加速器，並結合 GPU-PNM 混合執行模型與穩態 token 選擇策略，以維持大 batch size。

evaluation_and_results.baselines_compared: NVIDIA DGX appliance with A100-80GB GPUs, ArkVale

key_improvements.en: Up to 21.9x throughput improvement, up to 60x lower energy per token, and up to 7.3x better total cost efficiency.
key_improvements.zh: throughput 最高提升 21.9x，每 token 能耗最高降低 60x，總體成本效率最高改善 7.3x。

title: ShadowServe: Interference-Free KV Cache Fetching for Distributed Prefix Caching
authors: Xingyu Xiang; Raj Joshi; Yuhan Liu; Jiayi Yao; Chenxingyu Zhao; Junchen Jiang; Yang Zhou; Eddie Kohler; Minlan Yu
affiliations: Harvard University, University of Chicago, University of Washington, UC Davis

problem_statement.en: KV cache fetching in distributed prefix caching is bottlenecked by limited network bandwidth, and existing compression solutions cause significant interference with model computation when decompressed on the GPU.
problem_statement.zh: 分散式 prefix caching 中的 KV cache 抓取受限於有限的網路頻寬，而現有的壓縮方案在 GPU 上解壓縮時，會對模型計算造成顯著干擾。

key_innovation.en: ShadowServe, a SmartNIC-accelerated system that offloads KV cache fetching and decompression to the SmartNIC, using a chunked pipeline and minimal-copy memory management to eliminate host-side interference.
key_innovation.zh: ShadowServe 是一個以 SmartNIC 加速的系統，將 KV cache 的抓取與解壓縮卸載至 SmartNIC，藉由分塊流水線與最小化拷貝記憶體管理，徹底消除主機端的計算干擾。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.2x lower loaded TPOT, up to 1.38x lower TTFT in low-bandwidth scenarios, and up to 1.35x higher throughput.
key_improvements.zh: 負載下 TPOT 最低降至原來的 1/2.2；低頻寬情境中 TTFT 最低降至原來的 1/1.38；throughput 最高提升 1.35x。

title: Slim Fly: A Cost Effective Low-Diameter Network Topology
authors: Maciej Besta; Torsten Hoefler
venue: Int Conf High Perform Comput Netw Storage Anal
venue_full: International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage and Analysis

problem_statement.en: High-performance computing and datacenter networks face challenges with high latency, high costs, and energy consumption due to sub-optimal network diameters in existing topologies.
problem_statement.zh: 高效能運算與資料中心網路因現有拓撲的次優網路直徑，而面臨高 latency、高成本與高能耗等挑戰。

key_innovation.en: Slim Fly, a high-performance, cost-effective network topology based on graphs that approximate the solution to the degree-diameter problem, achieving near-optimal network diameter.
key_innovation.zh: Slim Fly 是一種高效能且具成本效益的網路拓撲，以近似求解 degree-diameter 問題的圖論結構為基礎，實現接近最優的網路直徑。

title: Splitwise: Efficient generative LLM inference using phase splitting
authors: Pratyush Patel; Esha Choukse; Chaojie Zhang; Aashaka Shah; Íñigo Goiri; Saeed Maleki; Ricardo Bianchini

problem_statement.en: Generative LLM inference consists of a compute-intensive prompt computation phase and a memory-intensive token generation phase, leading to resource underutilization when both phases are run on the same machine. This results in inefficient GPU usage and high costs for cloud service providers.
problem_statement.zh: 生成式 LLM inference 由計算密集的 prompt 計算階段與記憶體密集的 token 生成階段組成，在同一機器上共同運行時資源利用率低落，導致 GPU 使用效率不佳並推高雲端服務商的成本。

key_innovation.en: Splitwise, a deployment and scheduling technique that decouples the prompt computation and token generation phases onto separate machines, enabling phase-specific hardware optimization and efficient KV-cache transfer.
key_innovation.zh: Splitwise 是一種部署與排程技術，將 prompt 計算與 token 生成階段解耦合至獨立機器，從而實現各階段的針對性硬體優化與高效的 KV cache 傳輸。

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.4x higher throughput at 20% lower cost, or 2.35x more throughput under the same power and cost budgets.
key_improvements.zh: 在成本降低 20% 的前提下 throughput 最高提升 1.4x；或在相同功耗與成本預算下 throughput 可達 2.35x。

title: Spritz: Path-Aware Load Balancing in Low-Diameter Networks
authors: Tommaso Bonato; Ales Kubicek; Abdul Kabbani; Ahmad Ghalayini; Maciej Besta; Torsten Hoefler

problem_statement.en: Existing load balancing techniques for low-diameter topologies like Dragonfly and Slim Fly either rely on proprietary in-network mechanisms or fail to utilize full path diversity, leading to congestion and poor performance under link failures.
problem_statement.zh: 針對 Dragonfly 與 Slim Fly 等低直徑拓撲的現有負載均衡技術，或依賴專有的網內機制，或無法充分利用路徑多樣性，導致鏈路故障時出現壅塞與效能下降。

key_innovation.en: Spritz, a sender-based load balancing framework that shifts adaptive topology-aware routing to endpoints using standard Ethernet features (ECN, packet trimming, and timeout feedback) to explore and cache efficient paths.
key_innovation.zh: Spritz 是一個以發送端為核心的負載均衡框架，利用標準 Ethernet 特性（ECN、封包修剪及逾時反饋），將自適應拓撲感知路由移至端點執行，進而探索並快取高效路徑。

evaluation_and_results.baselines_compared: ECMP, UGAL-L, Minimal, Valiant, Flicr, OPS

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.8x throughput increase in flow completion time and up to 25.4x performance improvement under link failures.
key_improvements.zh: 流完成時間 throughput 最高提升 1.8x；鏈路故障情境下效能最高改善 25.4x。

title: STrack: A Reliable Multipath Transport for AI/ML Clusters
authors: Yanfang Le; Rong Pan; Peter Newman; Jeremias Blendin; Abdul Kabbani; Vipin Jain; Raghava Sivaramu; Francis Matus

problem_statement.en: Standard RoCEv2 suffers from ECMP hash collisions, poor load balancing, and inefficient loss recovery in large-scale AI/ML clusters, leading to network hotspots and performance degradation.
problem_statement.zh: 標準 RoCEv2 在大規模 AI/ML 叢集中面臨 ECMP 雜湊碰撞、負載均衡效果差及遺失恢復效率低等問題，導致網路熱點與效能下降。

key_innovation.en: STrack, a hardware-offloaded reliable multipath transport protocol that uses egress-marked ECN for adaptive packet spraying and a window-based congestion control algorithm that jointly optimizes path selection and rate adjustment.
key_innovation.zh: STrack 是一種硬體卸載的可靠多路徑傳輸協定，利用出口標記的 ECN 實現自適應封包噴射，並採用基於視窗的壅塞控制演算法，聯合優化路徑選擇與速率調節。

key_improvements.en: Up to 6X throughput increase with synthetic workloads and 27.4% improvement with collective workloads compared to optimized RoCEv2.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於優化後的 RoCEv2，合成 workload 下 throughput 最高提升 6x，collective workload 下提升 27.4%。

title: StreamRL: Scalable, Heterogeneous, and Elastic RL for LLMs with Disaggregated Stream Generation
authors: Yinmin Zhong; Zili Zhang; Xiaoniu Song; Hanpeng Hu; Chao Jin; Bingyang Wu; Nuo Chen; Yukun Chen; Yu Zhou; Changyi Wan; Hongyu Zhou; Yimin Jiang; Yibo Zhu; Daxin Jiang

problem_statement.en: Colocated RL architectures suffer from resource coupling, where the memory-bandwidth-bound generation stage and compute-bound training stage are forced to share identical hardware, leading to poor scalability and inefficient resource utilization. Additionally, existing disaggregated frameworks face performance bottlenecks due to pipeline bubbles from stage dependencies and skewness bubbles from long-tail output length distributions.
problem_statement.zh: 共置式 RL 架構因資源耦合而受限：記憶體頻寬瓶頸的生成階段與計算瓶頸的訓練階段被迫共用相同硬體，導致擴展性差且資源利用率低。此外，現有解耦合框架因階段依賴產生的 pipeline bubble，以及輸出長度長尾分布引起的偏斜 bubble，而面臨效能瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: StreamRL, a disaggregated RL framework that abstracts generation and training into a Stream Generation Service (SGS) and Trainer, utilizing stream-based communication, skewness-aware scheduling with an output-length ranker, and dynamic resource adjustment to enable elastic, heterogeneous, and cross-datacenter training.
key_innovation.zh: StreamRL 是一個解耦合 RL 框架，將生成與訓練抽象為 Stream Generation Service（SGS）與 Trainer 兩個元件，藉由流式通訊、帶有輸出長度排序器的偏斜感知排程及動態資源調配，實現彈性、異質且跨資料中心的訓練。

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.66x throughput increase compared to state-of-the-art systems and up to 1.33x improvement in cost-effectiveness in heterogeneous, cross-datacenter settings.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於最先進系統，throughput 最高提升 2.66x；在異質跨資料中心設定下，成本效益最高改善 1.33x。

title: Prefill-Decode Aggregation or Disaggregation? Unifying Both for Goodput-Optimized LLM Serving
authors: Chao Wang; Pengfei Zuo; Zhangyu Chen; Yunkai Liang; Zhou Yu; Ming-Chang Yang
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Huawei Cloud, Sun Yat-sen University

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems face a fundamental trade-off between PD aggregation (optimal for tight TTFT) and PD disaggregation (optimal for tight TPOT), leading to sub-optimal goodput under balanced SLO constraints.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統在 PD aggregation（最適嚴格 TTFT）與 PD disaggregation（最適嚴格 TPOT）之間存在根本性的取捨，導致在均衡 SLO 約束下 goodput 欠佳。

key_innovation.en: TaiChi, a unified serving system that leverages a hybrid aggregation-disaggregation architecture with differentiated-capability GPU instances and request-level latency shifting via flowing decode and length-aware prefill scheduling.
key_innovation.zh: TaiChi 是一個統一服務系統，採用混合 aggregation-disaggregation 架構，搭配差異化能力的 GPU 實例，並透過流動式 decode 與長度感知 prefill 排程實現 request 層級的 latency 調移。

title: Taming Throughput-Latency Tradeoff in LLM Inference with Sarathi-Serve
authors: Amey Agrawal; Jayashree Mohan; Nipun Kwatra; Bhargav Gulavani; Alexey Tumanov
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems face a throughput-latency tradeoff where prefill-prioritizing schedulers improve throughput but cause generation stalls, while decode-prioritizing schedulers optimize latency but suffer from low throughput.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統面臨 throughput-latency 的取捨困境：優先 prefill 的 scheduler 可提升 throughput，但會造成生成停滯；而優先 decode 的 scheduler 雖能優化 latency，卻導致 throughput 偏低。

key_innovation.en: Sarathi-Serve introduces chunked-prefills to split prompt processing into smaller compute units and stall-free scheduling to coalesce these chunks with ongoing decodes, minimizing latency impact while maximizing GPU utilization.
key_innovation.zh: Sarathi-Serve 引入 chunked-prefill，將 prompt 處理拆分為更小的計算單元，並以無停滯排程將這些 chunk 與進行中的 decode 合批，在最大化 GPU 利用率的同時將 latency 影響降至最低。

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.7x higher serving capacity for Yi-34B, 2.6x for Mistral-7B, and 5.6x gain in end-to-end serving capacity for Falcon-180B.
key_improvements.zh: Yi-34B 的服務容量最高提升 3.7x，Mistral-7B 提升 2.6x，Falcon-180B 的端到端服務容量提升 5.6x。

title: The development of carbon-neutral data centres in space
authors: Ablimit Aili; Jihwan Choi; Yew Soon Ong; Yonggang Wen
affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Zhejiang University, Korea Advanced Institute of Science & Technology, Agency for Science, Technology and Research

problem_statement.en: Terrestrial data centres suffer from high energy consumption and large carbon footprints, while space-based data generation faces high latency and energy costs when processed on Earth.

key_innovation.en: A framework for carbon-neutral orbital data centres (edge and cloud) that leverages abundant solar energy in space and deep space as a natural cold heat sink for radiative cooling.
key_innovation.zh: 針對碳中性軌道資料中心（邊緣與雲端）所提出的框架：利用太空中豐沛的太陽能，並以深太空作為天然冷熱沉以實現輻射散熱。

title: Theoretically Optimal Attention/FFN Ratios in Disaggregated LLM Serving
authors: Chendong Song; Meixuan Wang; Hang Zhou; Hong Liang; Yuan Lyu; Zixi Chen; Yuwei Fan; Zijie Zhou
affiliations: HKUST, Tsinghua University, Huawei Hong Kong Research Center, Peking University

problem_statement.en: The Attention/FFN provisioning ratio in Attention-FFN Disaggregation (AFD) architectures is highly sensitive, where mis-sizing leads to step-level blocking and device idle time. Existing systems rely on empirical search rather than a theoretical foundation to determine the optimal ratio.
problem_statement.zh: Attention-FFN Disaggregation（AFD）架構中的 Attention/FFN 資源配置比例高度敏感，比例設定不當將導致步驟級阻塞與裝置閒置。現有系統依賴經驗性搜索而非理論基礎來確定最優比例。

key_innovation.en: A tractable analytical framework and closed-form rules for the optimal Attention-to-FFN (A/F) ratio, derived from a probabilistic workload model that accounts for non-stationary KV cache growth and continuous batching.
key_innovation.zh: 一個可解析的分析框架與求解最優 Attention-to-FFN（A/F）比例的閉合公式，源自考量 KV cache 非平穩增長與 continuous batching 的機率性 workload 模型。

key_improvements.en: Theoretical optimal A/F ratio matches simulation-optimal within 10% relative error, and the framework consistently reduces idle time.
key_improvements.zh: 理論最優 A/F 比例與模擬最優結果的相對誤差在 10% 以內，且該框架在各情境下均能持續降低裝置閒置時間。

title: Towards a future space-based, highly scalable AI infrastructure system design
authors: Blaise Agüera y Arcas; Travis Beals; Maria Biggs; Jessica V. Bloom; Thomas Fischbacher; Konstantin Gromov; Urs Köster; Rishiraj Pravahan; James Manyika

problem_statement.en: The rapid growth of AI compute demand and energy consumption necessitates a more efficient, scalable infrastructure, which is currently limited by terrestrial constraints like land and power availability.
problem_statement.zh: AI 計算需求與能源消耗的快速增長迫切需要更高效、可擴展的基礎設施，而地面環境的土地與電力供應限制正制約著這一發展。

key_innovation.en: A space-based AI infrastructure using a constellation of solar-powered satellites in LEO, utilizing free-space optical inter-satellite links (FSO ISLs) and radiation-tested TPU accelerators.

title: TraCT: Disaggregated LLM Serving with CXL Shared Memory KV Cache at Rack-Scale
authors: Dongha Yoon; Younghoon Min; Hoshik Kim; Sam H. Noh; Jongryool Kim

problem_statement.en: Disaggregated LLM serving architectures suffer from high latency and throughput bottlenecks caused by network-based (RDMA) transfer of KV tensors between prefill and decode workers.
problem_statement.zh: 解耦合 LLM 服務架構因 prefill 與 decode worker 之間透過網路（RDMA）傳輸 KV tensor，而面臨高 latency 與 throughput 瓶頸。

key_innovation.en: TraCT, a rack-scale system that uses CXL shared memory as a network-free KV-transfer substrate and prefix-aware KV cache, enabling direct GPU-to-CXL DMA.
key_innovation.zh: TraCT 是一個機架規模系統，以 CXL 共享記憶體作為無需網路的 KV 傳輸基底，並結合前綴感知 KV cache，實現 GPU 至 CXL 的直接 DMA。

key_improvements.en: 9.8x average TTFT reduction, 6.2x P99 latency reduction, 1.6x peak throughput increase
key_improvements.zh: 平均 TTFT 降低 9.8x，P99 latency 降低 6.2x，峰值 throughput 提升 1.6x。

title: Vidur: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for LLM Inference
authors: Amey Agrawal; Nitin Kedia; Jayashree Mohan; Ashish Panwar; Nipun Kwatra; Bhargav S Gulavani; Ramachandran Ramjee; Alexey Tumanov
venue_full: Conference on Machine Learning and Systems

problem_statement.en: Optimizing LLM inference deployment is prohibitively expensive due to the massive configuration space and the high cost of experimental exploration on actual hardware. Misconfiguration can lead to significant performance degradation and cost inefficiencies.
problem_statement.zh: LLM inference 部署的優化因龐大的配置空間與在真實硬體上進行實驗探索的高昂成本而代價極高；配置不當將導致顯著的效能下降與成本浪費。

key_innovation.en: Vidur, a high-fidelity, extensible simulation framework for LLM inference that uses operator-level profiling and predictive modeling to estimate performance metrics, coupled with Vidur-Search for automated, cost-effective configuration optimization.
key_innovation.zh: Vidur 是一個高保真、可擴展的 LLM inference 模擬框架，透過算子級 profiling 與預測建模來估算效能指標，並結合 Vidur-Search 實現自動化的低成本配置優化。

key_improvements.en: Estimates inference latency with less than 9% error; reduces configuration search cost by several orders of magnitude (e.g., $125 in simulation vs $218K on hardware for LLaMA2-70B).
key_improvements.zh: inference latency 估算誤差低於 9%；配置搜索成本降低數個數量級（例如 LLaMA2-70B 的搜索成本：模擬僅需 $125，而在硬體上需 $218K）。

title: Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention
authors: Woosuk Kwon; Zhuohan Li; Siyuan Zhuang; Ying Sheng; Lianmin Zheng; Cody Hao Yu; Joseph E. Gonzalez; Hao Zhang; Ion Stoica

problem_statement.en: Existing LLM serving systems suffer from significant memory waste due to internal and external fragmentation of the KV cache, which is stored in contiguous memory and pre-allocated based on maximum sequence lengths. This limits the batch size and overall throughput of LLM serving.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 LLM 服務系統因 KV cache 的內部與外部碎片化而造成嚴重記憶體浪費——KV cache 以連續記憶體儲存並依最大序列長度預先分配，進而限制了 batch size 與整體 throughput。

key_innovation.en: PagedAttention, an attention algorithm that partitions the KV cache into fixed-size blocks and manages them using virtual memory and paging techniques, enabling non-contiguous memory storage and flexible memory sharing.
key_innovation.zh: PagedAttention 是一種 attention 演算法，將 KV cache 切分為固定大小的 block，並以虛擬記憶體與分頁技術加以管理，實現非連續記憶體儲存與靈活的記憶體共享。

key_improvements.en: 2-4x throughput increase, near-zero KV cache memory waste, and significant memory savings through sharing (up to 55% in beam search).
key_improvements.zh: throughput 提升 2-4x，KV cache 記憶體浪費趨近於零，並透過共享實現顯著的記憶體節省（beam search 場景下最高節省 55%）。

title: Why we should train AI in space
authors: Adi Oltean; Philip Johnston

problem_statement.en: Terrestrial data centers face severe energy supply constraints, permitting bottlenecks, and cooling limitations that hinder the scaling of gigawatt-sized AI training clusters.
problem_statement.zh: 地面資料中心面臨嚴峻的能源供應限制、許可審批瓶頸與散熱限制，阻礙了 GW 級 AI 訓練叢集的規模擴展。

key_innovation.en: Orbital data centers utilizing high-intensity 24/7 solar power, passive radiative cooling in deep space, and modular, scalable compute containers deployed via heavy-lift launch vehicles.
key_innovation.zh: 軌道資料中心方案：利用高強度全天候太陽能、深太空被動輻射散熱，以及透過重型運載火箭部署的模組化可擴展計算容器。

key_improvements.en: Energy costs reduced to ~$0.002/kWh, 95%+ solar capacity factor, elimination of fresh water usage for cooling, and removal of terrestrial permitting constraints.
key_improvements.zh: 能源成本降至約 $0.002/kWh，太陽能容量係數超過 95%，散熱完全無需淡水，且徹底免除地面許可審批限制。
